$comment: Docs-truth mechanism #2 — the env-var registry. Every DECLARAGENT_* variable the runtime/installer reads must have an entry here, and every DECLARAGENT_* variable mentioned on the docs site must exist here. `documented: true` entries must appear in docs-site/docs/reference/env-vars.mdx. Enforced by scripts/env-vars-lint.ts (CI).

DECLARAGENT_BUILDER.note: 'on' enables the builder toolkit in the REPL.

DECLARAGENT_METRICS_PORT.note: Control-plane/metrics port for `up` (9464 detached default; 0 disables).

DECLARAGENT_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT_RPS.note: Overrides the provider token-bucket rate (up + fleet run).

DECLARAGENT_BASH_ENV_ALLOW.note: Comma-separated allowlist for bash-tool env passthrough.

DECLARAGENT_BASH_ENV_DENY.note: Comma-separated extra denylist for bash-tool env passthrough.

DECLARAGENT_CLI_VERSION.note: Overrides the version stamped into up state (ops/test).

DECLARAGENT_PREFIX.note: Installer: install prefix for the curl path.

DECLARAGENT_NO_CHECKSUM.note: Installer: skips SHA-256 verify. Never in production.

DECLARAGENT_NO_POSTINSTALL.note: npm installer: skips the binary download.

DECLARAGENT_USE_BINARY.note: npm launcher: '1' forces the compiled binary over the Bun + dist path.

DECLARAGENT_SIZE_BUDGET_MB.note: Build-only: binary size budget for the release script.

DECLARAGENT_TOOLS_LEGACY.note: Rollout escape hatch: 'on' restores pre-WS1 tool-permission behavior. Deliberately undocumented; removed after the 0.8.0 cutover.

DECLARAGENT_FLEET_VERSION.note: Injected by fleet-run/renderers for version-skew stamping — not operator-set.

DECLARAGENT_FLEET_NAME.note: Injected by fleet-run for child processes — not operator-set.

DECLARAGENT_AGENT_ID.note: Injected by fleet-run for child processes — not operator-set.

DECLARAGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN.note: Bearer token consumed via fleet.yaml hosts[].auth env: refs in examples/tests.
